entries.description: apt never installs a PHP module for apache, and Sury's php meta no longer pulls each new PHP version onto the box: it did so through roundcube, with the new version's apache module first in line

apache runs no PHP module and is back on mpm_event: Sury's php meta had brought in PHP 8.6 with its apache module, which ran a customer's .phtml and .phar as www-data, outside his PHP pool. The panel's PHP takes the meta's place for roundcube
